name: How does project management handle permitting and inspections?

mainEntity.name: How does project management handle permitting and inspections?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project management typically coordinates permit submissions, responds to plan check comments, schedules inspections, and works with inspectors to resolve any field conditions or corrections.
